AUTO-CRUISE CONTROL
TSB Revision
ENGINE AND EMISSION CONTROL
17-37
STEP 4. Check the harness wire between throttle position 
sensor connector B-07 and auto-cruise control-ECU 
connector C-20.
Q: Is the harness wire between throttle position sensor 
connector B-07 and auto-cruise control-ECU connector 
C-20 damaged?
YES : Repair harness wire and then check that diagnostic 
trouble code 17 is not output.
NO : Check that diagnostic trouble code 17 is not output. 
If diagnostic trouble code 17 is output, replace the 
auto-cruise control-ECU. (Refer to P.17-81.)
Then check that diagnostic trouble code 17 is not 
output.
